cues: A slim steel tip reaches recessed screw heads inside furniture joints and appliance housings.
Magnetized tips keep tiny screws attached while someone positions them overhead.
A broad, textured grip rests comfortably in the palm during repeated turns of stubborn screws.
Porcelain tiles retain a cool surface even after afternoon sunlight warms the room.
An umbrella canopy sheds rain through taut fabric stretched over folding ribs.
Freshly cut apples develop brown patches when exposed to air for several minutes.
